items.title: Jimmy Wormworth interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 6, 2002
items.q: Max Roach, Jackie McLean are pretty articulate. They certainly been involved in the teaching of the music at a high level

ctx.x: And I think there is some weight to, they probably want a younger spokesman.

And I can’t understand why, I mean Max Roach, Jackie McLean are pretty articulate. They certainly been involved in the teaching of the music at a high level long before Wynton ever became involved, and even going to school let alone teaching it.
Well Tracy has had a pretty good run—
